title: Nanterre prison: Symptom of France's overflowing carceral system
summary: Located in the suburbs of #Paris, the #prison in Nanterre was opened in 1991 and built to take in nearly 600 inmates. Today, there are over 1,200 sharing tiny cells. Nanterre is the symptom of a broader problem: the French #carceral system is one of the most overpopulated in #Europe.
